description_en: Queries data flow information of a CPFS file system
description_zh: 查询一个CPFS文件系统的数据流动信息
name: DescribeDataFlows

parameters.help_en:
The file system ID.

CPFS: must start with `cpfs-`, such as cpfs-125487\\.

CPFS for Lingjun: must start with `bmcpfs-`, such as bmcpfs-0015\\
parameters.help_zh:
文件系统ID。

CPFS：必须以`cpfs-`开头，例如cpfs-125487\\。

CPFS智算版：必须以`bmcpfs-`开头，例如bmcpfs-0015\\
parameters.name: file_system_id

fields.help_en:
The name of the filter key. Valid values:

DataFlowIds: filters by data flow ID.
FsetIds: filters by Fileset ID.
FileSystemPath: filters by the path of the Fileset in the CPFS file system.
SourceStorage: filters by the access path of the source storage.
ThroughputList: filters by the transmission bandwidth of the data flow.
Description: filters by the description of the Fileset.
Status: filters by data flow status
fields.help_zh:
筛选键的名称。取值：

DataFlowIds: 根据数据流动ID筛选。
FsetIds：根据Fileset ID筛选。
FileSystemPath：根据Fileset在CPFS文件系统中的路径筛选。
SourceStorage：根据源端存储的访问路径筛选。
ThroughputList：根据数据流动的传输带宽筛选。
Description：根据Fileset的描述筛选。
Status：根据数据流动状态筛选
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The value of the filter key. Wildcards are not supported for this parameter.

If Key is set to DataFlowIds, Value is set to a data flow ID or part of a data flow ID. You can specify one or more data flow IDs. A maximum of 10 data flow IDs can be specified. Example: `df-194433a5be31****` or `df-194433a512a2****,df-234533a5be31****`.

If Key is set to FsetIds, Value is set to a Fileset ID or part of a Fileset ID. You can specify one or more Fileset IDs. A maximum of 10 Fileset IDs can be specified. Example: `fset-1902718ea0ae****` or `fset-235718ea0ae****,fset-5122718ea0ae****`.
If Key is set to FileSystemPath, Value is set to a path or part of a path in the CPFS file system. The value must be 1 to 1024 characters in length.
If Key is set to SourceStorage, Value is set to the access path of the source storage. The maximum length is 1024 characters.
If Key is set to ThroughputList, Value is set to the transmission bandwidth of the data flow. Combined queries are supported.
If Key is set to Description, Value is set to the description or part of the description of the data flow.
If Key is set to Status, Value is set to the data flow status.
If Key is set to SourceStoragePath, Value is set to the access path of the source storage or part of the access path. The maximum length is 1024 characters
fields.help_zh:
筛选键的值。该参数不支持通配符。

Key取值为DataFlowIds时，Value取值为数据流动ID或数据流动ID的一部分。可以是一个或一组DataFlowId，数据流动ID最多可设置10个。例如，`df-194433a5be31****`或`df-194433a512a2****,df-234533a5be31****`。

当Key取值为FsetIds时，Value取值为Fileset Id或Fileset ID的部分。可以是一个或一组Fileset ID，Fileset ID最多可设置10个。例如，`fset-1902718ea0ae****`或`fset-235718ea0ae****,fset-5122718ea0ae****`。
当Key取值为FileSystemPath时，Value取值为CPFS文件系统中的路径或路径的一部分。长度为1~1024个字符。
当Key取值为SourceStorage时，Value取值为源端存储的访问路径。最长为1024个字符。
当Key取值为ThroughputList时，Value取值为数据流动的传输带宽且支持组合查询。
当Key取值为Description时，Value取值为数据流动的描述或描述的一部分。
当Key取值为Status时，Value取值为数据流动状态。
当Key取值为SourceStoragePath时，Value取值为源端存储访问路径或访问路径的一部分。最长1024个字符
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The filter keys for querying data flows
parameters.help_zh: 查询数据流动的筛选键
parameters.name: filters

parameters.help_en: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. If the return results are truncated, use NextToken to obtain content starting from the truncation point
parameters.help_zh: 当请求的返回结果被截断时，您可以使用NextToken再次发起请求，获取从当前截断位置之后的内容
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The number of results for each query.

Valid values: 10 to 100. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh:
每次查询结果的个数。

取值范围：10~100。默认值：20
parameters.name: max_results

DataFlow.description_en: The collection of data flow information

AutoRefresh.description_en:
The collection of automatic update policy information.

Only CPFS is supported
AutoRefresh.description_zh:
自动更新策略信息集合。

仅支持CPFS

RefreshPath.description_en:
The automatic update directory. CPFS only automatically checks whether the source data in this directory has been updated and automatically imports the updated data.

Limits:

The path must be 2 to 1024 characters in length.
The path must be encoded in UTF-8.
The path must start and end with a forward slash (/).

The directory must be an existing directory on CPFS and must be located within a Fileset that has data flows enabled
RefreshPath.description_zh:
自动更新目录，CPFS仅自动检查该目录下的源端数据是否发生更新并自动导入更新的数据。

限制：

长度为2~1024个字符。
使用UTF-8编码。
必须以/开头和结尾。

该目录必须是CPFS上的已有目录，且必须位于开启了数据流动的Fileset中

AutoRefreshInterval.description_en:
The automatic update interval. CPFS checks the directory for data updates at this interval and starts an automatic update task if data updates exist. Unit: minutes.

Valid values: 5 to 526600. Default value: 10.
Only CPFS is supported
AutoRefreshInterval.description_zh:
自动更新间隔时间。每隔该时间间隔，CPFS会检查目录内是否存在数据更新，如果有数据更新，启动自动更新任务。单位：分钟。

取值范围：5~526600。默认值：10。
仅支持CPFS

AutoRefreshPolicy.description_en:
The automatic update policy. After the source data is updated, this policy determines how the data updates are imported to CPFS. Valid values:

None: Data updates from the source are not automatically imported to CPFS. You can use data flow tasks to import data updates from the source.
ImportChanged: Data updates from the source are automatically imported to CPFS.
Only CPFS is supported
AutoRefreshPolicy.description_zh:
自动更新策略，源端数据更新以后，数据更新导入到CPFS的策略。包括：

None：源端的数据更新不自动导入CPFS，用户可通过数据流动任务导入源端的数据更新。
ImportChanged：源端的数据更新自动导入CPFS。
仅支持CPFS

CreateTime.description_en:
The time when the Fileset was created.

The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the format of `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`.
Only CPFS is supported
CreateTime.description_zh:
Fileset的创建时间。

执行ISO8601标准表示，返回格式：`yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`。
仅支持CPFS

Description.description_en:
The description of the data flow. 

Limits:

The description must be 2 to 128 characters in length.
The description must start with a letter or Chinese character and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.
The description can contain digits, colons (:), underscores (_), or hyphens (-)
Description.description_zh:
数据流动的描述。 

限制：

长度为2~128个英文或中文字符。
必须以大小写字母或中文开头，不能以`http://`和`https://`开头。
可以包含数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）或者短划线（-）

ErrorMessage.description_en:
The error message. Valid values:

None (default): The data flow is in a normal state.
SourceStorageUnreachable: The access path of the source storage is not found.
ThroughputTooLow: The data flow bandwidth is too low
ErrorMessage.description_zh:
错误信息。包括：

无（默认值）：表示该数据流动状态正常。
SourceStorageUnreachable：未查询到源端存储的访问路径。
ThroughputTooLow：数据流动带宽过低

FileSystemPath.description_en:
The path of the Fileset in the CPFS file system.

Limits:

The path must be 2 to 1024 characters in length.
The path must be encoded in UTF-8.
The path must start and end with a forward slash (/).
The directory must be a Fileset directory on CPFS.
Only CPFS is supported
FileSystemPath.description_zh:
Fileset在CPFS文件系统中的路径。

限制：

长度为2~1024个英文或中文字符。
使用UTF-8编码。
必须以/开头和结尾。
该目录必须是CPFS上的Fileset目录。
仅支持CPFS

FsetDescription.description_en:
The description of the automatic update.
Only CPFS is supported
FsetDescription.description_zh:
自动更新的描述。
仅支持CPFS

FsetId.description_en:
The Fileset ID.
Only CPFS is supported

SourceSecurityType.description_en:
The security protection type of the source storage. If the source storage must be accessed through security protection, specify the security protection type. Valid values:

None (default): The source storage does not require security protection for access.
SSL: Access is protected by an SSL certificate
SourceSecurityType.description_zh:
源端存储的安全保护类型，如果源端存储必须通过安全保护访问，请指定源端存储的安全保护类型。取值：

无（默认值）：表示源端存储不需要通过安全保护方式访问。
SSL：通过SSL证书保护访问

SourceStorage.description_en:
The access path of the source storage. Format: `<storage type>://[<account id>:]<path>`.

Where:

storage type: Only OSS is supported.
account id: The UID of the account to which the source storage belongs.
path: The name of the OSS bucket.
    - Only lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens (-) are supported. The name must start and end with a lowercase letter or digit.
    - The name must be 8 to 128 characters in length.
    - The name must be encoded in UTF-8.
    - The name cannot start with http:// or https://.

The OSS bucket must be an existing bucket in the region.
Only CPFS for Lingjun 2.6.0 and later support the account id parameter
SourceStorage.description_zh:
源端存储的访问路径。格式：`<storage type>://[<account id>:]<path>`。

其中：

storage type：目前只支持OSS。
account id：源端存储所属账号的UID。
path：OSS的bucket名称。
    - 仅支持小写字母、数字和短划线（-）且必须以小写字母或者数字开头和结尾。
    - 长度为8~128个英文字符。
    - 使用UTF-8编码。
    - 不能以http://和https://开头。

OSS Bucket必须为在该地域已存在的Bucket。
仅CPFS智算版2.6.0及以上版本支持account id参数

SourceStoragePath.description_en:
The access path within the source storage bucket.

Only CPFS for Lingjun is supported
SourceStoragePath.description_zh:
源端存储Bucket内的访问路径。

仅支持CPFS智算版
SourceStoragePath.title_zh: 源端存储内的访问路径。

Status.description_en:
The data flow status. Valid values:

Starting: The data flow is being created or started.
Running: The data flow has been created and is running normally. 
Updating: The data flow is being modified, such as increasing the transmission bandwidth or modifying the automatic update interval.
Deleting: The data flow is being deleted.
Stopping: The data flow is being stopped.
Stopped: The data flow has been stopped.
Misconfigured: The data flow configuration is abnormal, such as the source storage being inaccessible or the transmission bandwidth being too low to complete automatic updates
Status.description_zh:
数据流动状态。包括：

Starting：数据流动正在创建或启动中。
Running：数据流动已创建完成，正常运行中。 
Updating：数据流动正在发生修改，例如提升传输带宽、修改自动更新间隔时间。
Deleting：数据流动删除中。
Stopping：数据流动停止中。
Stopped：数据流动已停止。
Misconfigured：数据流动配置异常，例如源端存储无法访问，传输带宽过低无法完成自动更新

Throughput.description_en:
The maximum transmission bandwidth of the data flow. Unit: MB/s. Valid values: 

600
1200
1500

The transmission bandwidth of the data flow must be less than the I/O bandwidth of the file system.
Only CPFS is supported
Throughput.description_zh:
数据流动的传输带宽上限，单位：MB/s 。取值： 

600
1200
1500

数据流动的传输带宽必须小于文件系统的IO带宽。
仅支持CPFS

UpdateTime.description_en:
The time when the Fileset was last updated.

The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the format of `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`.
Only CPFS is supported
UpdateTime.description_zh:
Fileset的最近一次更新时间。

执行ISO8601标准表示，返回格式：`yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`。
仅支持CPFS

NextToken.description_en: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. If the return results are truncated, use NextToken to obtain content starting from the truncation point
NextToken.description_zh: 当请求的返回结果被截断时，您可以使用NextToken再次发起请求，获取从当前截断位置之后的内容
